the CSR efforts of African companies are strongly philanthropic and that GDP and level governance standard positively affect the extent of CSR website reporting.
CSR reporting in the African sample is strongly influenced by the socio economic and the political environment, and that CSR is mainly driven by local philanthropic activities.
CSR reporting is context dependent and that the socio economic and the political environment of sub Saharan countries influence CSR reporting.

the question of how CSR reporting is shaped in a developing region.

the African companies' CSR reporting is not only strongly context dependent but also very different from CSR practices in Western economies.

the African CSR context differs from the European and American context in a way that it is less developed, more focused on local philanthropy, less transparent and more influenced by political and economic conditions.

CSR is an issue in developing countries.

the institutional context of sub Saharan Africa shapes companies' CSR efforts.
